passages.title: Text 01
passages.text: Hi Rani, Please bring your blue notebook to class tomorrow. We need it for our English game. Thanks, Sita.

passages.title: Text 02
passages.text: LIBRARY NOTICE: The library is closed on Friday. Please return your books on Thursday.

passages.title: Text 03
passages.text: Hello, Dika! It is my birthday on Sunday. Come to my house at 2 p.m. We can eat cake together. — Ben

passages.title: Text 04
passages.text: PLEASE BE QUIET. Students are taking a test in this room.

passages.title: Text 05
passages.text: Mila, your lunch is on the kitchen table. Please take it before you go to school. Love, Dad.

passages.title: Text 06
passages.text: ART CLUB: Do you like drawing? Join us on Tuesday after school in Room 5. Bring a pencil. Everyone is welcome!

passages.title: Text 07
passages.text: Dear Ms Ana, I am sick today, so I cannot come to school. I will do my homework at home. — Riko

passages.title: Text 08
passages.text: BUS 4: The bus leaves at 7:15 a.m. Please be at the stop by 7:10.

passages.title: Text 09
passages.text: Hi Nina, Thank you for helping me with my homework yesterday. I understand the lesson now! — Wati

passages.title: Text 10
passages.text: To make tea, put a tea bag in a cup. Add hot water. Wait two minutes. Then drink.

passages.title: Text 11
passages.text: Hi everyone! Our class photo is on Wednesday, not Tuesday. Please wear your school uniform. See you then! — Class teacher

passages.title: Text 12
passages.text: Mom, I am at the school library. I will come home at four, not three. I have a group project. — Aldi

passages.title: Text 13
passages.text: KEEP THE PARK CLEAN. Put your rubbish in the bins. Do not leave bottles on the grass.

passages.title: Text 14
passages.text: Hi Bima, I have your red ruler. You left it on my desk. I can give it back at lunch. — Tono

passages.title: Text 15
passages.text: SPORTS DAY: Games start at 8 a.m. on Saturday. Bring water and a hat. Parents can come and watch.

passages.title: Text 16
passages.text: Hello Sari, I finished your storybook. It was fun to read! Can I give it back to you tomorrow after class? — Putri

passages.title: Text 17
passages.text: Hi friends! The football game is not at the school field today. It is at the town park at 4 p.m. Please come to the park. — Fajar

passages.title: Text 18
passages.text: Hi art club members! We will meet in Room 8 today, not Room 3. Please tell one friend about the new room so everyone can find us. — Nia

passages.title: Text 19
passages.text: The front gate is closed today. Use the small gate next to the library. Please do not wait at the front gate.

passages.title: Text 20
passages.text: Dear class, Our trip is tomorrow. The bus leaves at 7 a.m. Bring your lunch and be at school by 6:45. We cannot wait for late students. — Ms Rina

questions.prompt: Why does Sita write this note?
choices: To tell Rani about a holiday
To ask Rani to bring a notebook
To invite Rani to buy a notebook
To say the game is over
questions.evidence: Please bring your blue notebook to class tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Sita meminta Rani membawa buku catatan biru ke kelas untuk permainan bahasa Inggris.

questions.prompt: Why is this notice written?
choices: To ask students to read on Friday
To invite students to the library
To sell books to students
To tell students the library is closed on Friday and ask them to return their books on Thursday.
questions.evidence: The library is closed on Friday. Please return your books on Thursday.
questions.explanation: Pengumuman memberi tahu perpustakaan tutup Jumat dan meminta buku dikembalikan Kamis.

questions.prompt: Why does Ben write this message?
choices: To invite Dika to his birthday
To ask Dika to make a cake
To tell Dika to go to school
To thank Dika for a gift
questions.evidence: Come to my house at 2 p.m. We can eat cake together.
questions.explanation: Ben mengundang Dika datang ke rumah untuk merayakan ulang tahunnya.

questions.prompt: Why is this sign here?
choices: To tell students to start a game
To ask students to open the door
To ask people to be quiet
To invite people into the room
questions.evidence: PLEASE BE QUIET. Students are taking a test in this room.
questions.explanation: Tulisan meminta orang menjaga ketenangan karena ada siswa yang sedang ujian.

questions.prompt: Why does Dad write this message?
choices: To ask Mila to cook lunch
To tell Mila where her lunch is and remind her to take it
To ask Mila to buy lunch
To invite Mila to eat at a cafe
questions.evidence: your lunch is on the kitchen table. Please take it before you go to school.
questions.explanation: Ayah memberi tahu letak bekal dan mengingatkan Mila untuk membawanya.

questions.prompt: Why was this poster made?
choices: To explain how to draw a face
To tell students the art room is closed
To ask students to clean Room 5
To invite students to join art club
questions.evidence: Join us on Tuesday after school in Room 5.
questions.explanation: Poster mengajak siswa bergabung dengan klub seni.

questions.prompt: Why does Riko write this note?
choices: To explain why he is absent
To ask for a new school bag
To invite his teacher home
To tell his teacher to stay home
questions.evidence: I am sick today, so I cannot come to school.
questions.explanation: Riko menjelaskan alasan ia tidak masuk sekolah.

questions.prompt: Why was this notice written?
choices: To ask people to drive a bus
To tell people to buy a ticket
To help passengers arrive on time
To invite passengers to a party
questions.evidence: The bus leaves at 7:15 a.m. Please be at the stop by 7:10.
questions.explanation: Pengumuman memberi waktu keberangkatan dan mengingatkan penumpang datang lebih awal.

questions.prompt: Why does Wati write this email?
choices: To ask Nina for more homework
To tell Nina to study alone
To invite Nina to a lesson
To thank Nina for her help
questions.evidence: Thank you for helping me with my homework yesterday.
questions.explanation: Wati berterima kasih atas bantuan Nina.

questions.prompt: Why was this text written?
choices: To tell a story about tea
To show how to make tea
To invite someone for tea
To ask someone to buy tea
questions.evidence: put a tea bag in a cup. Add hot water. Wait two minutes.
questions.explanation: Teks memberi langkah sederhana membuat teh.

questions.prompt: Why does the teacher send this message?
choices: To tell students about a new photo day and what to wear
To ask students to take photos at home
To thank students for taking photos
To invite students to buy uniforms
questions.evidence: Our class photo is on Wednesday, not Tuesday. Please wear your school uniform.
questions.explanation: Guru memberi tahu perubahan hari foto kelas dan pakaian yang harus dikenakan.

questions.prompt: Why does Aldi send this message?
choices: To ask Mom to visit the library
To invite Mom to join his project
To tell Mom he will be home later
To ask Mom to bring a book
questions.evidence: I will come home at four, not three. I have a group project.
questions.explanation: Aldi memberi tahu ibunya bahwa ia pulang lebih lambat karena proyek kelompok.

questions.prompt: Why was this sign put in the park?
choices: To tell people where to play
To ask visitors to keep the park clean
To invite visitors to bring bottles
To explain when the park opens
questions.evidence: Put your rubbish in the bins. Do not leave bottles on the grass.
questions.explanation: Papan meminta pengunjung menjaga kebersihan taman.

questions.prompt: Why does Tono write this note?
choices: To ask Bima to buy a ruler
To ask Bima to clean his desk
To invite Bima to study after school
To tell Bima he has his ruler and can return it
questions.evidence: I have your red ruler. You left it on my desk. I can give it back at lunch.
questions.explanation: Tono memberi tahu Bima bahwa penggarisnya ada pada Tono dan bisa dikembalikan saat makan siang.

questions.prompt: Why was this note written?
choices: To tell families about sports day and what to bring
To ask parents to play every game
To tell students sports day is cancelled
To explain how to make a hat
questions.evidence: Games start at 8 a.m. on Saturday. Bring water and a hat. Parents can come and watch.
questions.explanation: Catatan menginformasikan acara olahraga, perlengkapan yang perlu dibawa, dan bahwa orang tua boleh menonton.

questions.prompt: Why does Putri write this message?
choices: To thank Sari for the book
To ask to return the book tomorrow
To say she finished the book and ask to return it tomorrow
To say she enjoyed reading the book
questions.evidence: I finished your storybook. It was fun to read! Can I give it back to you tomorrow after class?
questions.explanation: Putri memberi tahu Sari bahwa ia sudah selesai membaca buku dan meminta izin mengembalikannya besok. Pilihan lain hanya memuat satu bagian pesan atau menambah tujuan yang tidak disebut.

questions.prompt: Which answer best explains why Fajar writes this message?
choices: To tell friends the new place of the game
To tell friends the new place and ask them to come there
To ask friends to come to the park
To tell friends what time the game starts
questions.evidence: The football game is not at the school field today. It is at the town park at 4 p.m. Please come to the park.
questions.explanation: Fajar menjelaskan bahwa tempat pertandingan pindah ke taman kota dan meminta teman-teman datang ke sana. Menyebut lokasi atau ajakan saja belum merangkum seluruh pesan.

questions.prompt: Which answer best explains why Nia writes this message?
choices: To ask members to tell a friend
To tell members the meeting room has changed
To tell members the club meeting is cancelled
To tell members the new room and ask them to tell a friend
questions.evidence: We will meet in Room 8 today, not Room 3. Please tell one friend about the new room so everyone can find us.
questions.explanation: Nia memberi tahu perubahan ruang pertemuan dan meminta anggota menyampaikan informasi itu kepada seorang teman. Kedua tujuan harus tercakup.

questions.prompt: Why did they write this notice?
choices: To tell students the front gate is closed and show them another gate
To tell students the front gate is closed
To tell students to use the small gate
To tell students where the library is
questions.evidence: The front gate is closed today. Use the small gate next to the library.
questions.explanation: Pengumuman menjelaskan bahwa gerbang depan ditutup dan mengarahkan siswa memakai gerbang kecil. Menyebut penutupan atau gerbang pengganti saja belum lengkap.

questions.prompt: Which answer best explains why Ms Rina writes this message?
choices: To remind students what to bring
To remind students when to arrive
To remind students when to arrive and what to bring
To remind students when the bus leaves
questions.evidence: The bus leaves at 7 a.m. Bring your lunch and be at school by 6:45.
questions.explanation: Pesan mengingatkan siswa membawa bekal dan datang paling lambat pukul 6.45. Pilihan tentang bekal, waktu datang, atau jam bus saja hanya menjelaskan sebagian isi.
